units.source_text: 母亲果然满足了我的愿望，闭着眼睛笑了笑，说：“很好啊。”

en.t: Mother, as I had hoped, granted my wish; she smiled with her eyes closed and said, "Very well."

units.source_text: 当时，坏心眼的哥哥刚好不在家，去丸佐古董店了。

en.t: At that moment, my spiteful elder brother happened to be out of the house, having gone to the Marusa antique shop.

units.source_text: 那一瞬间我好像忘了刚才经历的所有不愉快，赶紧坐上了人力车。

en.t: In that instant, I seemed to forget all the unpleasantness I had just gone through and hurriedly climbed into the rickshaw.

units.source_text: 我把毯子盖在膝上，人力车的轮子发出“咕噜咕噜”的声音，出发了。

en.t: I spread the blanket over my knees, and with the rickshaw wheels rumbling, we set off.
